comments.body:
Ok, here is what ETH considers:

1) Your GPA and rank.
2) Your schools reputation. A Harvard 3.8 is not the same as random uni 3.8.
3) Your letters of rec.

Its not a good look to get a B in an essential class, but they judge you academically as a whole. Just apply, because NO ONE apart from the admissions office can tell you for sure.
comments.author: FriedBrainCells2401
